name: invalid selected plan
evidence: The plan resolver reports missing required structure.

name: unaccepted candidate
evidence: An acceptance-required candidate has no verified receipt and no earlier accepted plan.

name: later pending candidate
evidence: A valid accepted plan remains selected while a later candidate awaits its receipt.

name: planned label without accepted plan
evidence: The issue has planned but the first acceptance-required plan has no valid receipt.

name: criterion source drift
evidence: A recorded active criterion source no longer matches its locator digest.

name: incomplete reconciliation
evidence: A prior active criterion has no valid disposition in the receipt.

name: active and historical criteria
evidence: One active criterion is unchecked; a separately replaced criterion is historical and not part of the gate count.

name: reconciled history
evidence: A replaced criterion remains visible as history with its successor locator.

name: invalid native dependency edge
evidence: GitHub returned a blocker edge whose target cannot be found as a stage issue.

name: actual open blocker
evidence: GitHub returned an open blockedBy edge; issue-number ordering alone is not evidence.

name: partially completed operation
evidence: Issue creation succeeded but one requested native dependency link failed; no automatic retry or rollback follows.
